permissions.name: audio.capture
permissions.reason: Listens to the conversation through the glasses microphone so Media Link on this phone can turn it into text.

permissions.name: audio.playback
permissions.reason: Plays silence while you listen with the phone mic, so the phone keeps the page running and the glasses keep getting cues.

permissions.name: device.events
permissions.reason: Stops listening with a plain message when the glasses disconnect.

permissions.name: device.messaging
permissions.reason: Shows short text cues on the glasses and receives your taps.

permissions.name: network
permissions.reason: Talks to Media Link on this phone (127.0.0.1). Media Link sends the recent words to Cerebras (Fast) or Claude (Careful) for the cue.

permissions.name: storage
permissions.reason: Saves your settings and, if you tick it, summaries on this phone.
